outcome: Coagulation markers (vWF, GMP-140, platelet count, fibrinogen levels, PT, APTT)
cohort: Eighty pregnant women with severe pre-eclampsia who elected to deliver by cesarean section were randomly assigned to a control or ulinastatin group.
finding: Ulinastatin attenuates vascular endothelial cell damage in pregnant women with severe pre-eclampsia, as indicated by decreased plasma concentrations of vWF and prolonged APTT.
